result.summary:
I found 5 defects in the security-perf dimension: 1 high, 3 medium, 1 low. Security is clean apart from one low item. Performance has three real layout-shift bugs and one bundle regression. I changed no repo files. Scripts, page captures and screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/74a692da-26dd-57ab-b4f9-90621aaa7a8a/scratchpad/cr-security-perf/.

SECURITY (all checks pass except finding credits-licence-links-http)
- Every dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink gets only HTML that renderInline or renderTokens built. Those sinks are in question, quick-check, final-test, flashcards, scene, section, blocks and diagram.
- I bundled the parser and fed it 45 hostile inputs. Raw HTML, comments, entities, HTML in headings, tables, diagram YAML, flashcards, question parts and scene captions, images, and links were all refused or escaped. The links covered javascript:, data:, http:, protocol-relative, reference-style, autolinks, www., email, and quote breaks in href or title.
- Plain-text scene fields render as React text.
- The comments API, comments module, db and Discussion are unchanged from fae17a9.
- No link anywhere uses target=_blank, so reverse tabnabbing can't happen.
- localStorage: I tried 16 junk or hostile values (bad JSON, null, arrays, __proto__ and constructor keys, HTML as slugs, 1e308 scores, far-off dates, 5,000-deep nesting), plus a throwing localStorage getter and a throwing setItem. No errors, every page rendered, and the Final test still submitted.
- The diff holds no secrets or private data. It has only placeholders like ${{ secrets.X }}, example emails and commit SHAs.
- vercel.json is the only Vercel config change.
- content/ returns 404 over HTTP and is not in any client chunk. Neither are zod, yaml, the shuffle code or the db code. Diagrams render on the server.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS (Playwright and the build's route-bundle-stats)
- First-load JS, raw / gzip:

| Route | Raw | Gzip |
|---|---|---|
| /learn/[slug] | 553 KB | 167 KB |
| / and /courses/[course] | 488 KB | 147 KB |
| /credits | 480 KB | 144 KB |
| /progress | 474 KB | 142 KB |
| Framework baseline | 465 KB | 138 KB |

- /learn/[slug] adds 87 KB raw of its own; 64 KB of that is the lesson chunk.
- Hydrated client components:
  - /learn/tdd: about 54 client-component instances (16 QuickCheck, 16 Link, 3 Image, 2 DoneTick, then Reveal, HeaderOverlay, DonePill, QuickCheckRail, Flashcards, FinalTest, Discussion). That is 133 React component fibers.
  - Longest Lesson, /learn/lab-gated-pipeline (8.6k words, 2,127 DOM nodes): about 88 instances, including 30 CopyButton and 20 QuickCheck. That is 202 fibers.
- Total blocking time:
  - 0 ms on both Lessons at normal CPU speed, 1440px.
  - CPU slowed 4× with slow 4G, 375px: tdd 151 ms, lab 479 ms.
  - CPU slowed 4×, 1440px: 229 ms and 436 ms.
  - Most of it is relayout of the whole long page when the fonts swap in and when the page's code runs.
- LCP is the hero image at first paint. Only heroes load eagerly; they use fetchPriority=high and a preload.
- Layout shift when loading at the top of the page: 0 at 375–1440×900. On 1920×1200 and 2560×1440 it is 0.013–0.041, from the margin rail.
- next/image: every image has sizes. Source files are at most 1600px and 400 KB, served as 20–130 KB WebP.
- Fonts: next/font self-hosts Inter and Inter Tight with font-display swap and metric-adjusted fallbacks. Two latin woff2 files (93 KB) are preloaded.
- Answering a Quick check on the longest Lesson at 1440px with the CPU slowed 4× takes 152–264 ms. The rail re-measures every Section on each answer. At 375px it takes 64–88 ms.

OUTSIDE MY DIMENSION (not verified further)
- The three renamed slugs redirect, but Comments stored under the old slugs are no longer shown, because nothing migrated them.
- The first request for an unknown /courses/x or /learn/x returns 200 with a noindex not-found page. Later requests return 404. This is Cache Components behaviour.
- Nothing was measured in Safari or Firefox; only Chromium is installed here.

findings.where: src/app/learn/[slug]/quick-check-rail.tsx:87-88 (also :59 and :79-80); src/app/globals.css:3236-3254. Seen at http://localhost:3300/learn/tdd and /learn/lab-gated-pipeline at 1280px and wider.
findings.problem: The margin rail only takes Quick checks out of the text after hydration. The layout effect sets data-rail, which applies position:relative to the Section, position:absolute to the checks, display:none to the numeral stage, and min-height writes. Any load that isn't at the very top therefore reflows thousands of pixels of text after the first paint. Because position and min-height change on ancestors of the visible text, Chrome's scroll anchoring doesn't hold the reader in place. Repro at 1440×900 (1280 behaves the same): (1) Open /learn/tdd and scroll until the Remember flashcards are 200px from the top. Reload. The flashcards end up 5,437px above the screen and the view shows the Sources list after the Final test. Reloading with the 9th Quick check in view leaves it 2,601px above the screen. (2) Open /learn/tdd#going-deeper. With JS off the heading sits at 93px; with JS it ends 2,680px above the screen. #practice-scenarios ends 5,530px above, #when-to-use-it 730px, and /learn/lab-gated-pipeline#traps 6,967px. At 1279px the same reloads and anchors land correctly (200, 175 and 93px). (3) Layout shift: 0.315 at 1280px and 0.254 at 1440px on reload with the first Quick check in view; 0.19–0.23 when loading /learn/tdd#what-it-s-for. With the CPU slowed 4× on slow 4G, a reader who scrolls 1,300px before the code runs sees the line under them jump 319px (shift 0.69).
findings.fix: Don't change the text's layout after first paint. At 1280px and wider, apply the margin layout in CSS keyed on [data-quick-checks] instead of [data-rail]: the Section gets position:relative, the checks get position:absolute in column 2 with visibility:hidden until the rail has set their top and data-rail, and the numeral stage is hidden. For readers without JavaScript, restore the in-text layout with a <noscript><style> override, as layout.tsx already does for the header. In place(), keep the reader's view steady: measure the first text block in view before writing min-height and top, then window.scrollBy the difference. On the first placement, if location.hash names an element and the reader hasn't scrolled, scroll it back into view. Re-measure only the Section whose size changed, not every Section on each ResizeObserver callback.

findings.where: src/app/learn/[slug]/quick-check.tsx:51-121; src/app/learn/[slug]/final-test.tsx:101-103, 107-115, 122-178; src/app/learn/[slug]/flashcards.tsx:31-47 (switched by useHydrated, src/app/progress/use-progress.ts:17). Affects /learn/* at every width.
findings.problem: Quick checks, the Final test and the flashcards first render a no-JS version: radios plus a 'Show the answer' <details>, and both card faces stacked. Once useHydrated() turns true they switch to an interactive version of a different height. Measured on /learn/tdd at 375px, JS off vs on: each Quick check goes from 412 to 337px, the Final test band from 7,588 to 7,200px, and the flashcards from 1,345 to 1,520px. The flashcards move up 1,203px (1,489px on /learn/lab-gated-pipeline). Repro: at 375px, scroll /learn/tdd to the flashcards and reload. The first paint shows text about 1,200px earlier in the Lesson, then everything jumps when the code runs (layout shift 1.0; 0.65 at 1279px). With the CPU slowed 4× on slow 4G, the wrong text is on screen for about 0.8s. A reader on a slow phone who scrolls 2,600px before hydration sees the paragraph under them jump 147px (shift 0.24). Section links on long Lessons land about 300px off below 1280px: on /learn/lab-gated-pipeline#traps at 375px the heading sits at −254px instead of 81px. For a Lesson already Done, the Done banner is also inserted above the questions after hydration.
findings.fix: Make the server HTML take the same space as the hydrated UI. Hide the no-JS-only parts (the 'Show the answer' details and the no-JS lead text) by default and show them through a <noscript><style> rule. Server-render the Final test bar (answered count plus an inert Submit) and the flip-card layout, so hydration only adds behaviour. Reserve the Done banner's height, or place it where inserting it doesn't push the questions down.

findings.where: src/app/progress/progress-view.tsx:25 (`if (!hydrated) return null;`). Seen at http://localhost:3300/progress, 375px and 1440px.
findings.problem: ProgressView renders nothing until hydration. The first paint shows the heading and the lead with the site footer right under them; then the whole Course list renders and pushes the footer off screen. This happens on every load, with or without saved progress. Repro: open /progress. Layout shift is 0.483 at 375×900, and 0.289 (nothing Done) or 0.334 (3 Lessons Done) at 1440×900. With the CPU slowed 4× on slow 4G, the footer sits in view for about 1.8s before jumping.
findings.fix: Server-render the static part: the list of Courses with their links, titles and CourseProgress bars, which already keep their place until hydration. Fill in only the per-Visitor parts afterwards: the summary sentence, the Done Lesson lists and the Reset button. Alternatively, render the same structure with reserved, hidden placeholders while hydration hasn't happened.

findings.where: src/app/learn/[slug]/flashcards.tsx:6 (htmlToText imported from @/lessons/markdown, used at :56). Ends up in .next/static/chunks/0lfsx4pfho1n_.js, which every /learn/* page loads.
findings.problem: The client Flashcards component imports htmlToText from @/lessons/markdown. That module imports marked at the top and creates a Marked instance (gfm, the mark extension, the task-box renderer) when it loads. As a result Turbopack ships the whole Markdown parser to every Lesson page. In the build, the Flashcards module is 49,489 B. Of that, 47,361 B (14.2 KB gzip) is marked plus markdown.ts; the chunk contains marked's own strings, such as 'Please report this to https://github.com/markedjs/marked'. The component itself is 2,128 B. That is 74% of the Lesson route's own chunk (64,361 B). /learn/[slug] ships 552,745 B raw (166.7 KB gzip), against 488,384 B for / and /courses/*. The browser never parses Markdown. This is a regression: before this branch only server code imported markdown.ts.
findings.fix: Move htmlToText and its ENTITIES map into a module with no dependencies, such as src/lessons/text.ts, that markdown.ts re-exports and flashcards.tsx imports. Alternatively, compute plain frontText and backText in parseFlashcards on the server and pass them as props. To check, `grep -l markedjs .next/static/chunks/*.js` should print nothing.

findings.where: src/lessons/course-lint.ts:244-248 (only credit.source is checked); src/app/credits/page.tsx:30 (<a href={credit.licenseUrl}>); content/image-credits.json in the image build (not yet committed)
findings.problem: /credits renders each licence as a link to licenseUrl, but nothing checks licenseUrl. The lint only requires source to start with https://, and the home page photos' credits aren't linted at all. In the manifest the served build uses, 9 of 86 licenseUrls are plain http://, for example /images/lessons/agents-in-github-actions.jpg links to http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. So /credits links over plain http, which the Lesson parser refuses for Lesson links.
findings.fix: In checkPhoto or parseCredits, require licenseUrl to be null or to match ^https://\S+$, the same rule as source. Run the check on the home page photos' credits too. Change the 9 entries to https://creativecommons.org/….
